mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments ( order_id, toss_order_id, payment_key, idempotency_key, method, amount, status, provider_status, failure_code, failure_message ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{tossOrderId}, #{paymentKey}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{method}, #{amount}, 'READY', #{providerStatus}, #{failureCode}, #{failureMessage} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, toss_order_id, payment_key, idempotency_key, method, amount, status, provider_status, active_paid_order_id, active_ready_order_id, failure_code, failure_message, requested_at, approved_at, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM payments WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id
